A1/A2 are complete and ready for A3 review. A4 was not started because approval has not been received.

Artifacts:

- [Audit findings](/root/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/audit/wave4-topology.findings.md)

Key results:

- All 39 statements classified `ai-altered` / `semantic-source` using HTTP-verified sources.
- All 33 proof-bearing items and 419 direct Fact citations are covered, including item-specific eight-case worksheets.
- One repeated class-(a) falsehood: compactness is not independent of the ambient space unless the induced topology is unchanged.
- Three class-(b) citation repairs: arbitrary-set sequences incorrectly cite the real-sequence definition.
- The strict contract gate fails only for six genuinely unused Fact citations in three items; their deletion or relocation is queued as owner-only A10 work.
- Finite-smoke passes. Risk routing sends all 33 proofs to Alpha: 28 critical and 5 high.
- No published item or page was edited.
